projectDescription: Self-hosted, open-source RAG platform that turns your company's documents into an AI knowledge base with multilingual retrieval, source-traceable answers, and an OpenAI-compatible API — with no vendor lock-in on the underlying language model.
keyFeatures: Self-hosted RAG platform — your documents, your infrastructure, no vendor lock-in
Hybrid dense + sparse (BM25) retrieval with cross-encoder reranking
Multilingual retrieval supporting cross-language queries (92% accuracy benchmark)
OpenAI-compatible REST API (chat completions, files, assistants, threads)
Official TypeScript SDK (@webamigos/ragen-sdk-ts) with streaming support
LiteLLM proxy integration — route to OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex, or local models
MCP integrations for Google Drive, Google Calendar, Gmail, HubSpot, ClickUp, Slack
Embeddable chatbot widget for customer-facing deployments
AES-256-GCM envelope encryption at rest with Scaleway KMS, AWS KMS, or local key
Permissions enforced at retrieval — not just in the UI
Multi-tenancy with one Qdrant collection per organization
Document types: PDF, DOCX, EPUB, Markdown, TXT, CSV, XLSX, SRT, Images, URLs
Audit log and 21-event security event log with email alerting
Admin panel for platform-wide management of orgs, users, keys, usage, and feature flags
publicApiSurface: POST /v1/chat — Send a message and receive a RAG-grounded answer
POST /v1/chat/completions — OpenAI-compatible chat completions with full RAG pipeline
POST /v1/files — Upload a file for ingestion
POST /v1/search — Search knowledge base, returns context + file_ids without generating an answer
MCP tool: ragen_chat — Chat with a Ragen assistant via MCP
MCP tool: ragen_list_assistants — List assistants via MCP
SDK: Ragen.chat.completions.create() — Create a chat completion
SDK: Ragen.chat.completions.stream() — Stream a chat completion
SDK: Ragen.files.waitUntilProcessed() — Poll until file is ingested
SDK: Ragen.files.uploadAndWait() — Upload and wait for processing
npx create-ragen-app — Scaffold a new Ragen installation
